newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHARES SEEN UP WEDNESDAY AFTER ONE-DAY DIP.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHARES SEEN UP WEDNESDAY AFTER ONE-DAY DIP.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to rise on Wednesday after Tuesday's 0.8-percent dip that followed a six-session 14.5-percent surge.
Analysts said a good sign was Tuesday's restrained fall in lower turnover but it was not yet clear to what degree heightened foreign buying was speculative or long-term.

They said Tuesday's news the co-ruling Peasant Party (PSL) would seek to dismiss the prime minister over farm policy might have limited effect on the bourse as it could be seen as electioneering ahead of September's parliamentary elections.
Viscoplast resumes trade on the parallel market on Wednesday after a month-long suspension due to flooding.
